_comment: The conformance linter, which is the evidence behind every claim that the generated COBOL is Enterprise COBOL. Nothing was checking the checker: a rule whose test still passes when the rule is inverted is not a rule, and the 2026-08-06 audit found five assertions in this repository that ran, passed and checked the wrong thing. Reading finds those one at a time; a surviving mutant is that defect by definition. See docs/verification.md.
